60-74.opener: Decent effort, but a few things to address.

40-59.opener: Your pressing form needs significant attention.

grip_ratio.note: grip_ratio=(grip_width - shoulder_width)/shoulder_width; ideal 20-120% wider than shoulders.

rom_top.note: 50% of ROM score. Max elbow extension at top of press. >= 157° = full extension (100), <= 110° = poor extension (0). 153° ~= 92.

rom_bottom.note: 50% of ROM score. Binary check: did elbow landmark (13/14) go below shoulder landmark (11/12) in image Y coords at bottom frames?

max_elbow_angle.note: 3D elbow angle at lockout, sustained >= 0.5 s

elbow_flare.note: angle between upper-arm (elbow→shoulder) and torso-down (hip→shoulder) during concentric phase. At bottom: ~90deg; at lockout: ~170deg. Ideal concentric mean: 90-150deg. Excluded from diagonal views due to foreshortening.

shoulder_elevation.needs_work: Work on pressing the bar fully overhead.
shoulder_elevation.focus_here: Your lockout is incomplete — the bar needs to finish directly over your shoulders.

elbow_extension.needs_work: Focus on fully extending your elbows at the top.
elbow_extension.focus_here: Elbow extension is insufficient — lock out completely at the top of each rep.

combined_cue.needs_work: Work on your lockout: press higher and extend the elbows fully.
combined_cue.focus_here: Your lockout needs significant work — incomplete extension and insufficient height.

error_cues_phase3.lockout: Press fully overhead — finish each rep with elbows locked.
error_cues_phase3.elbow_flare: Elbows flared wide — keep them under the bar.
error_cues_phase3.smoothness: Press tempo was jerky — drive smoothly through the movement.
error_cues_phase3.control: Bar wandered — control the path top to bottom.
error_cues_phase3.grip_ratio: Grip width is off — aim for just outside shoulder width.
error_cues_phase3.rom_top: Incomplete top extension — press to full lockout overhead.
error_cues_phase3.rom_bottom: Incomplete bottom depth — lower the bar to chin/upper chest level.
error_cues_phase3.knee_error: Knees buckled during the press — brace and stabilise your stance.
